text: Rohan, welcome to Month 5. We are introducing endurance work now. Starting with two 25-minute sessions of zone-2 cardio per week, while maintaining your three strength sessions.
Got it. How should I measure zone-2 intensity? Recovery 65% this morning.
Use your Garmin to keep heart rate between 120-130 bpm. You should still be able to talk, but not sing. That's the sweet spot.
Did my first cardio session this morning. HR was around 126 on average. Recovery 62%.
Perfect. That's exactly where we want you. Over time this will improve your cardiovascular efficiency and support lipid management.
BP this week is averaging 122/78. HRV 60ms. Feeling less sore after strength sessions. Recovery 64%.
That's excellent. It shows your system is adapting to the combined load. Keep logging sleep daily – endurance can sometimes impact recovery at first.
Sleep was only 5.5 hours last night due to late work. HRV dropped to 52ms. Recovery 51%.
That's a noticeable dip. Take today as active recovery – light walk and stretching. Skip cardio until HRV is back above 55ms.
Rohan, we've scheduled a follow-up blood panel for August 18. This will help us see how endurance training is influencing lipids and ApoB.
Okay. Same fasting as before, right? Recovery 66% today.
Yes, 12 hours fasting. Water is fine. We'll review results the same day.
Your August panel shows ApoB has dropped further since June. Lipid ratios are trending positive, hs-CRP is steady.
That's motivating. I was worried the extra training might increase inflammation. Recovery 68% this morning.
Good concern. But with your recovery practices, inflammation is stable. We'll keep monitoring hs-CRP each quarter.
From a nutrition angle, increase oily fish to twice weekly. This will reinforce the lipid improvements.
Completed two cardio sessions and three strength this week. HRV averaging 59-61ms, BP steady at 124/79. Recovery 66%.
That's a balanced adaptation. Endurance hasn't disrupted recovery – excellent sign. Keep this routine steady for the rest of the month.
Month 5 summary: ApoB improved, recovery stable, endurance successfully added. In September, we'll increase endurance frequency slightly and add periodic intervals.
Understood. I feel more energetic overall. Looking forward to progressing endurance next month. Recovery 67%.
